name: Belzutifan

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm and harm to an unborn baby

summary: In the United States, Belzutifan has a boxed warning for heart harm and harm to an unborn baby [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, evaluated the drug's potential effects on organs [M]. This computer model gave Belzutifan a high score of 74 for liver harm and a low score of 38 for heart harm [M].
